executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 90 errors across multiple test classes. The primary issues are: (1) Type incompatibility between enum types (TaskStatus, TaskPriority) and String in test data setup, (2) Missing setter/getter methods in DTO classes (TaskResponse, PagedTaskResponse, BulkTaskResponse), and (3) Method signature mismatches in service interfaces. These errors indicate that the DTO classes were refactored to use records or immutable patterns without updating the test code accordingly.

errors.message: Incompatible types: TaskStatus/TaskPriority enum cannot be converted to String (35 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code is attempting to pass enum values (TaskStatus, TaskPriority) to methods expecting String parameters. The entity or DTO classes likely changed from String to enum types, but test code was not updated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test methods to use .name() or .toString() when passing enum values to methods expecting String. Example: change 'TaskStatus.OPEN' to 'TaskStatus.OPEN.name()' and 'TaskPriority.HIGH' to 'TaskPriority.HIGH.name()'.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: setVersion, setPage, setLast, setSuccessCount, setFailureCount, setErrors methods
errors.root_cause: DTO classes (TaskResponse, PagedTaskResponse, BulkTaskResponse) were likely converted to Java records or immutable classes, removing setter methods. Test code still attempts to use setters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Refactor test code to use builder pattern or constructor-based initialization instead of setters. For records, use: 'new TaskResponse(id, title, description, status, priority, assigneeId, columnId, version)' instead of creating empty object and calling setters.

errors.message: Method getUserTasks signature mismatch: expects (Long, Pageable) but called with (Long, int, int, String)
errors.root_cause: The TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature was refactored to accept a Pageable object instead of individual pagination parameters (page, size, sort).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update test code to create Pageable objects: 'PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortField))' and pass it to getUserTasks() instead of individual parameters. Import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest and Sort.

errors.root_cause: BulkTaskError inner class is missing from BulkTaskResponse. It was either removed or moved to a separate class file.
errors.fix_recommendation: Create BulkTaskError as a separate record or class in the dtos package, or restore it as an inner class in BulkTaskResponse. Define it with fields: taskId (Long), error (String).

errors.message: Type mismatch: ResponseEntity<com.myproject.exceptions.ErrorResponse> cannot be converted to ResponseEntity<com.myproject.models.dtos.ErrorResponse>
errors.root_cause: Two ErrorResponse classes exist in different packages (exceptions vs models.dtos). GlobalExceptionHandler returns the exceptions package version, but tests expect the dtos package version.
errors.fix_recommendation: Consolidate ErrorResponse into a single class in models.dtos package and remove the duplicate from exceptions package. Update GlobalExceptionHandler to import and return the dtos version. Update all test imports accordingly.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: handleConcurrentCreation and handlePerformanceThreshold methods
errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler is missing exception handler methods for ConcurrentTaskCreationException and PerformanceThresholdExceededException.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @ExceptionHandler methods in GlobalExceptionHandler: '@ExceptionHandler(ConcurrentTaskCreationException.class)' returning ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> with HTTP 409 status, and '@ExceptionHandler(PerformanceThresholdExceededException.class)' returning HTTP 503 status.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: getPage, getLast, getSuccessCount, getFailureCount, getErrors methods
errors.root_cause: DTO classes were converted to records with different field names or accessor patterns. Records use field names directly instead of get/set prefixes.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update test assertions to use record field accessors: 'response.page()' instead of 'response.getPage()', 'response.last()' instead of 'response.getLast()', etc. For records, accessors match field names without 'get' prefix.

summary: 7 grouped compilation errors found across test classes
